title: Reflex: author a lane — grammar, labels, refit, serve, ship
intro: Press play to walk the dev loop one step at a time, or click a dot to jump. Each step shows what goes in and what comes out where a wire exists — captured from the real release binary.

walk.title: Author the grammar
walk.text: Write the domain as sentences: a state sentence and option sentences in a closed grammar. The grammar bounds what can be asked — nothing outside it is ever answered.

walk.title: Label a slice
walk.text: A small set of your own labeled examples, kept offline. This is the only data the fit consumes — no telemetry feeds it.

walk.title: Refit the gates
walk.text: Fit the gate thresholds from your labels, offline, one-off. The calibrator stays bit-identical until you refit it.

walk.title: Serve on loopback
walk.text: Run the edge on your machine with one allowed origin. The health read is the loopback edge answering: which lanes are ready, which heads are fitted.

out.label: GET /healthz — the edge is up
out.from: captured from the reflex 0.2.4 release binary, 2026-10-03 · GET /healthz (healthz response)

walk.title: Decide
walk.text: The live path: an answer with calibrated confidence, or an honest abstain when the evidence is thin. This runbook question is answered by the corpus the loop just authored.

in.label: POST /decide — a question your corpus covers
in.from: captured from the reflex 0.2.4 release binary, 2026-10-03 · POST /decide (corpus_answered request)

out.label: the corpus's answer
out.from: captured from the reflex 0.2.4 release binary, 2026-10-03 · POST /decide (corpus_answered response)

walk.title: Ship the binary
walk.text: One static release per platform; the corpus and the fitted thresholds ride with it. Same binary, same answers, on every host.
